question: Sales revenues are 200 and 250, respectively, in units of ten thousand yuan, and the vertical axis starts at 150 in the same units. How many times as tall as the first bar is the second bar in the chart? How many times the first value is the actual second value? Give both ratios as decimals.
solution: The displayed heights are 50 and 100, respectively, so the second is 2 times as tall. The actual ratio is \(250\div200=1.25\), so the chart exaggerates the difference.

Two-digit integer division prepares legitimate two-digit-divisor cases. The stated criterion also permits a one-digit divisor, and the decimal-place extension can be learned from that simpler algorithm, so the entire two-digit trial-quotient method is not universal.
